# Mond(AI)y Coffee

Mond(AI)y Coffee is a free weekly coffee meetup for AI builders and curious minds in Atlanta.

## Core pages
- Home: https://mondaiycoffee.com/
- About: https://mondaiycoffee.com/about/
- Get involved: https://mondaiycoffee.com/get-involved/
- Meeting notes: https://mondaiycoffee.com/notes/
- Members: https://mondaiycoffee.com/members/

## Machine-readable indexes
- Sitemap: https://mondaiycoffee.com/sitemap.xml
- RSS: https://mondaiycoffee.com/index.xml
- Meeting notes RSS: https://mondaiycoffee.com/notes/index.xml
- Members JSON: https://mondaiycoffee.com/members/index.json
